name: Fexofenadine
summary: Non-sedating antihistamine that does not cross the blood-brain barrier at usual doses; effective for allergic rhinitis and chronic urticaria.
mechanism: Peripheral H1 receptor antagonist with no significant CNS penetration.

dosing.adult: 180 mg once daily or 60 mg twice daily

safety.pregnancy: No major teratogenicity demonstrated in animal and limited human data
safety.lactation: Excreted in breast milk; generally considered compatible
warnings: Fruit juices (grapefruit, orange, apple) reduce absorption — take with water
Take aluminum/magnesium antacids at least 2 h apart

clinicalPearls: Take with water, not fruit juice — juices cut absorption by roughly a third
P-glycoprotein substrate; drugs affecting P-gp can alter its levels
good: Essentially non-sedating with minimal drug interactions
bad: Renal impairment without dose reduction; situations needing very rapid onset
